notes.title: Wheelchair Wizards Patch 1.3 - The Modifier Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello my Paralyzed Prophets,

We've been playing around with a new modifier option to spice up your games! Modifiers are special round specific events such as things like low gravity, super speed, etc. It definitely has the potential to be buggy, but it's just for fun anyway.

Thank you for supporting Wheelchair Wizards!

Features:
-Modifiers
-Lifesteal Upgrade

Fixes:
-Negative cooldown reduction[/p]

notes.title: HATS ARE HERE! (PATCH 1.2.7)
notes.content:
Hey guys! We've dropped a new supporter pack for those who want to continue supporting our game and studio! It contains some silly hats for your wizard, and some of them even match the other pack!

As for changes, we've had some issues with the desync on the void heavy so we've changed it to a short teleport. Hopefully this shakes up the strategy in game! Other from that, theres been some bug fixes for leavers mid game and some for the sun element double hitting.

Thank you guys so much for supporting our game :)

notes.title: Wheelchair Wizards Patch 1.2 - The Desert Update - First Major Content Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello my favorite Wizards in Wheelchairs, [/p][p]We’ve cooked up some new content for you all in the week since launch! Just a quick heads-up updates this fast won’t be the norm. Going forward, we’ll be putting more time into our upcoming projects, but we’ll still be fixing issues as they pop up and staying active in our Discord.[/p][p]Now, about this update, there’s plenty to get excited about! We’re dropping a brand-new Desert Map, adding two new elements, and (finally!) introducing sound effects to bring the world of Wheelchair Wizards to life. On top of that, we’ve rolled out a bunch of balance changes and fixes to keep the gameplay feeling smooth and fun. We can’t wait to see you diving in and enjoying everything new![/p][p]Looking ahead to the week after this update drops, we’ve got something big planned; our first ever OFFICIAL Wheelchair Wizards tournament! We’re aiming to host it on August 11th, so mark your calendars. For all the details surrounding this event, be sure to join our Discord, as we’ll be revealing more over the next few days. But that’s not all, this coming week we’re also releasing our second Supporter DLC, featuring brand-new hat customization (a highly requested addition from you all). Keep an eye out for its release and grab it when it goes live![/p][p](PS. Check out our Instagram for a funny lil release trailer)[/p][p][b]– The Chromatophore Games Team
[/b][/p][h3][b]Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a New Desert Map with 6 unique levels and it's very own rap!,[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Sun Element with a light and heavy spell,[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Light Element with a light and heavy spell,[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects,[/p][/*][*][p]Added symbols for equipped elements in the HUD,[/p][/*][*][p]Added tags for players of notice in the lobby menu (ie. Tournament Winner, Developer etc.),[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balancing Reworks:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Nerfed Vine light attack damage,[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Vine heavy attack damage,[/p][/*][*][p]Added Vine stun cooldown,[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Magic heavy attack damage (PISS BEAM IS BACK),[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed falling out of the map,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional double hitting instances,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed map brightness issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with dlc shoping cart skin not showing up
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Wheelchair Wizards Patch 1.1 - Game Breaking Bug Fixes + Spell Reworks!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey all you Crippled Conjurers and Arcane Amputees![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you've been having a blast battling it out in the world of Wheelchair Wizards since launch! It's been a wild couple days, and we wanted to ROLL out a patch based on your feedback, fixing some game-breaking bugs, making balance tweaks, and sharing a bit about what’s coming next for the game and for our tiny "studio" Chromatophore Games (there’s only three of us lol).[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re just here for the full list of bug fixes, balance changes and new features, scroll on down. [/p][p][/p][p]First, we just want to say when we launched Wheelchair Wizards, we didn’t expect to do much with it afterward. Honestly, we thought we’d drop it and move on with our lives. But the support you’ve all shown has blown us away. You’ve surpassed anything we imagined, so thanks to all of you. [/p][p]Looking ahead, we’re excited to say that more content is already in the works! You can expect a content update and more patches in the next week or two with new spells and possibly a new map. A lot of this content comes straight from your suggestions on Discord, so make sure to keep them coming. [/p][p]As for Chromatophore Games, we’ve already started working on our next project, which we can't talk about much yet but let me just say there are two goals in mind for this next game, a hard goal and an easier goal. The hard goal? Make it more fun than Wheelchair Wizards. The easier goal? Make it higher quality. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing. We’re just getting started. [/p][p][/p][h2]– The Chromatophore Games Team[/h2][p][/p][h2]Features:[/h2][list][*][p]Added host being able to define number of rounds to win in lobby settings,[/p][/*][*][p]Added impact explosion for ice light attack,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing Reworks:[/h2][list][*][p]Buffed non spell-specific upgrades,[/p][/*][*][p]Vine element light attack damage increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Vine element heavy attack damage increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Vine element heavy attack growth speed increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Ice element light attack damage increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Ice element heavy attack damage increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Fire element light attack damage increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Magic element heavy attack (AKA PISS BEAM AKA THE DEATHSTAR) damage decreased,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed lobbies with more than 2 players having scoring issues (hopefully),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed connection issues (hopefully),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bouncing upgrade for magic heavy attack not doing damage in some instances,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu issues,[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]
